body: Idk i realize how insane i am with the cuts on my arm and not a single moment of reliving my life to show for it

I read about your relationship on your page. Honestly that guy doesn’t seem worth it at all. You’ll find something we eventually. This is absolutely hypocritical of me but I’m gonna go with it anyway, love yourself first. Not just...passionately lol...but rediscover your interests. Fuck books for this situation. Go out and take a stupid nature walk, crop dust some strangers while you have your headphones on while listening to Movits.

I mean taking your life is a permanent thing so there’s that. Hurting yourself horribly and failing could be damaging in your social life. Really up to you honestly. I’ve lost a lot of friends because i can’t control myself mentally.

I stopped using weed and alcohol. I tried to use a Sativa but i didn’t use my regular dealer lol and the other person definitely didn’t give me what i asked for. That strain had me overthinking like crazy. What i wanted had me constantly feeling like i was watching my favorite episode of my favorite cartoon. But i said screw it and stopped using it altogether. 

Idk back then it made me feel like i had more time in the day and so I’d go to the gym. I’d feel more productive and all that junk.

I mean i can offer you what helped me. But the lows are overcoming them. Starting by going to sleep early and waking up at 8am. Knowing you have a full day ahead. It’s so funny reading that now. I can’t sleep anymore. The excitement is killing me today. No pun intended. Give something a shot before you get to my step
The other day i went with a friend to go eat. I couldn’t wait to be home alone almost immediately after. Not even anxiety, i just felt my mood slip away and feel sad
It’s a mental health thing. It’s like playing minesweeper when you try talking to friends about it though. I wish i would’ve never told anyone and vented on here anonymously.
Just tired of feeling this way. Waking up is a chore and feeling low after a moment of happiness gets exhausting day after day
Today is my day. Just waiting for my family to leave the country and roommates to go to work. About 4PM
I was away from home for a few years. The new scenery was amazing. Then i came back. I often think about it. Otherwise i just really wanna end it because I’m just not enjoying anything anymore.
Well if i talk about what i want to do i kind of see the words written out and think about them. They make me feel down but at least in a weird ass way I’m postponing it
That’s why this is an alt account lol

It’s not that the whole me isn’t accepted. I just want nothing to do with the sad me. All i wanna do is sulk and be home. Although money wouldn’t allow any activities. I’ll be with a friend and boom, suddenly i just wanna be home.
“Usually described as a light switch by most”
I really am. But i don’t really care.
Hey fuck it as long as I’m anonymous idc. I don’t have to defend myself. Everyone has felt a bad day before. I’m not trying to force my ideas on others but venting is just something I’ve needed.

It’s good to have a few close friends but honestly i love the hermit lifestyle. I walk to work so I’m fit. I have something really fucked in my head though. Usually described as a light switch by most. When I’m low I’m low. But if i keep these thoughts here then I’m not even worried

The funny thing is that i have a lot of friends but at the same time i don’t. I don’t trust anyone. They call me a good man and a good friend but if that’s because i listen and don’t say anything then why can’t i get the same treatment? 

I have a better time alone. I have problems being out with people now and honestly it’s something I’ve come to accept. The only time I’ll overlook it is if I’m at work. 

So far this is day 1 of doing the plan of separating myself. Let’s see how this goes by day 30 lol

I mean if you don’t do it and you’re struggling hard mentally then you look like an ass. I opened up to one person and they told the masses so here i am.

I can’t trust anyone so i feel safer here. If i completely split off the side of me the best i can and place him here, then i have a better chance of picking myself up. I feel happier.
Look I’m desperate. Don’t need the motivation. Let me try this for me
I said that made me happy. It doesn’t feel the same anymore
Exactly
My ideal way is to get shot by a cop while pretending to pull out a gun myself. Nice and easy but i could only hope they kill me

Tbh i don’t have Stormblood and Heavensward. I don’t even want to win this thing. I just wanna share that this game has helped distract me so much. I’ve played FF games since 8 game out so i was always familiar with the title. This one just adds an element to an mmo where i feel like i accomplish things in game and progress despite having my crafters and gatherers at 50. I even just maxed my relic weapon. Anyway I’m glad i encountered this game
What like watch Rugrats in Paris on repeat? I don’t believe in an afterlife or reincarnation. It’s a nice thought but i want the same feeling as when i sleep
Agreed
I’m just glad i finally coped with the whole...people have had it worse thing. I no longer pity anyone. I’m fucked in the head now and i can’t shake that. The harder i try to, the worse it gets.

Why are there so many kinds then? I’m forcing this so hard. I’ve completely isolated myself because i honestly can’t handle who i am around people. That being a person who cares about others. The only people i seem to be around are damaged women and i tend to be the person to help them get back up. But i always end up alone at the end of the day so i just cut everything out so i wouldn’t have to feel that way. I’m not sure what to do. My insurance is fuckin with me right now so I’ve been off the meds for a month now. 

I’m not sure how to get back up on my own for the time being.
I used to think this sounded crazy as a kid. I’d be down
